text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp has begun. I want to use this
opportunity to get Nishino
Flower to relax
and open up around me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to work hard so I can grow even
more as an Umamusume!
Oh, but I'm also
fine with doing solo training!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I have to make sure I don't burden
Trainer. I should be careful with
what I ask
for.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But it's obvious that she's doing her best
to make herself unobtrusive.
I can already
feel a distance forming between us.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... I think I'll do one more lap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower runs at an unsteady pace.
Her determination to push
past her limits is
affecting her performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp is a getaway from the
everyday, so I want her to enjoy
her time
here. What can I do to help her relax?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Telling her she doesn't have to try so hard
or that she ought to have
fun would
probably end up having the opposite
effect.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I could take a kinder, softer
approach, like how she does with
everyone
else around her...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thinking back on the time I've spent with
Nishino Flower, the solution
suddenly
comes to me. I don't know if it'll work, but
I'll put my whole
heart into the effort.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I couldn't run the way I wanted from start
to finish...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Hello? Mom... Dad... What's going
on?

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for calling in the middle of summer
camp, but we haven't heard
from you in a
while and were starting to worry.

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
We know you tend to keep things to
yourself, so we thought we'd
reach out
instead.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: U-um, actually...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
And I keep thinking I need to get myself
together, so I don't bother
Trainer, but...
Nothing I try works.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer's busy. I don't want to waste their
time, but I still...

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Mom?

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Flower... You remind me of your father and
I when we were younger.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
Maybe you could try being more open
with your feelings. I'm sure
Trainer wants
that as well.

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I know you're worried about burdening the
people you care about,
but... I don't think
that's how your trainer views it.

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
After all, you're both trying your best to
understand each other. You
can do that by
letting them get to know you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Understand... each other?

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
You have to be brave, but I know you can
do it, Flower. Because
you're the one who
gave your mother and I courage.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Do you really think I can?

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text: Of course! Besides, hasn't your trainer also given you courage?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sob. I... I'm... so sorry...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I remember what Trainer said to me when
I cried.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Let me be your trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Those words shook me to my core.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "You gave me courage too."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Your words also gave me courage.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Mom, Dad. Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... Sigh... Phew! Trainer, I'm done with the final lap!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer? Before we eat, I... I want to
tell you something!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
F-for the longest time, I was worried that I
was bothering you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Uh, like the day you went out for lunch
with the other trainers. I gave
you that
bento without even considering that you
might have had
plans already.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
All you did was tell me you liked the food,
but I was so happy that... I
went
overboard...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that I was invited to lunch after I
finished eating her food. I
truly was happy
about receiving it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
R-really? Then... I misunderstood again...
I... Oh, this is so
embarrassing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take out a bento box from my cooler bag.
It's a token of the
appreciation I'd been
trying to convey to Nishino Flower for so
long.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
A bento... f-for me? And you made it
yourself?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I... I'm so happy right now!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Ehehe. Right! I put my heart into the
lunch I made for you, and
I'm sure yours
was made the same way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We have lunch by the beach. Nishino
Flower happily bites into a
slightly burned
omelet.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Next time, let's try a bento exchange. I'll
make sure to include lots of
your favorite
foods.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That's why, um... Could you maybe put my
favorite foods in the one
you make, too?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we spend an enjoyable lunch
talking about Nishino Flower's
favorite and
least favorite foods, as well as new things
she wants to
try out.
